title: Cherish the Lord by relying on mercy
summary: Let mercy and grace reach the heart before effort strains. Do not let the day outrun this: hold onto this: bring the truth about failure into the Lord's mercy.
lifeApplication: When shame or effort makes devotion feel heavy, stop trying to earn warmth. Ask for mercy and let affection come from there.

source.shortMeaning: Love ripens where the heart leans on mercy instead of merit.
source.lifeApplication: When devotion feels heavy, ask for mercy before trying harder.
